title: external no-pulse pedestal closure for pseudo-pedestal risk atoms

pre_registered.reproduction: exact S00 selected B-stave pulse count from raw h101/HRDv ROOT
pre_registered.split: leave one Sample-II analysis run out; train on all other analysis runs
pre_registered.win_rule: lowest held-out >5 ns downstream pair timing-shift tail fraction, then >0.5 ns tail fraction, then sigma68; pedestal RMSE is diagnostic
pre_registered.external_closure_rule: if no forced/random/no-pulse B-stack ROOT source is visible, target-excluded pretrigger closure is diagnostic only and pseudo-pedestal corrections are not promoted to charge/live-time analyses

next_tickets.title: S16o: ingest manifest for true forced-random B-stack pedestal ROOT
next_tickets.body: Add a machine-readable ingest contract for true forced/random or no-pulse B-stack pedestal ROOT runs, including trigger-mode metadata, run numbers, checksums, and expected non-beam trigger entries. Expected information gain: turns S16n's absent-from-mirror diagnostic result into a direct electronics-pedestal validation once the acquisition records are mounted.
